section_summary.extract_value: This section presents hierarchical regression analyses examining predictors of general sexual liberalism, stratified by gender. In women (n=146-142), sexual orientation was a significant predictor in step 1, and body appreciation, sexual orientation, and BMI emerged as significant predictors in step 2. In men (n=158-152), only step 2 reached significance, with body appreciation as the sole significant predictor.
